Priya: Quick sync  30m sparring tomorrow 9:30AM PT. Goal: lock 2 defensible benchmark lines, 3 SDR hooks, and a 1-slide rebut map vs cloud vendors + managed LLM APIs. Who's in? :crossed_swords:
Dylan: In. I'll bring the latency vs managed APIs and a short note on routing-level fallbacks.
Hannah: Ill upload P50/P95 charts (256/512 tokens) and the canary bench CSVs.
Omar: Drafting a compact competitor matrix: wins/losses for CVs, ManagedAPI, InfraVendors, and Redwood.
Riley: SDR hooks should be tight (<20 words). Suggest PLG, AE, and Infra-tech variants.
Priya: Draft hooks to iterate:
  PLG: "Ship chat features faster: predictable latency + lower token spend across hosted and private."
  AE: "SLA-backed inference with private deployments and dedicated capacity."
  Infra-tech: "Batching + KV caching + quant-friendly kernels = lower unit cost, preserved latency."
Dylan: Bench phrasing: avoid absolutes. Use qualifiers + link to appendix. e.g., "Up to 4x lower unit cost in our benchmark under typical chat loads."
Hannah: FYI staging 512-run medians: Redwood ~22ms, CloudX ~110ms on comparable GPU. Cost multipliers vary by quant/batch. I'll attach raw logs.
Omar: Rebut matrix should cover: "We already run CloudX"; "We need SLAs"; "We can't host private infra". Two-line rebut each.
Riley: Example rebut to "We already run CloudX": "They provide scale; we reduce per-token spend with intelligent batching and prefix caching, plus a straight migration path to dedicated/private."
Priya: Inbound routing rule for demo requests: if body contains latency|SLA|private|dedicated|throughput|predictable -> tag enterprise-sales; else route growth-inbound. SRD ops to implement.
launch-bot: Calendar invite sent for 09:30-10:00 PT to #marketing.
Dylan: Action items: Hannah -> bench appendix + CSVs; Omar -> 1-slide rebut map; Riley -> 3 SDR hooks + A/B copy; Priya -> stitch pre-read and run wargame.
Priya: Keep language conservative and cite appendix. We'll finalize after wargame and push a one-pager to SDRs by Friday. :thumbsup:
